text: {"assertions":["A corrupted scaffold bug was discovered in the init command of cli/commands/init.py","The bug occurs when initializing into a directory that already contains a lockfile","The bug manifests as a missing file in the generated tree on the first request after a cold start","Clock skew between two hosts was identified as the root cause of the corrupted scaffold bug","The fix switched the deadline mechanism to use a monotonic clock, implemented in PR #3835 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-1","The fix reduced job execution time from 7 hours to 42 minutes","The init command is covered by tests in tests/cli/test_init.py"]}
